post.description: Authenticate user and generate JWT token

get.description: Get inventory details by product ID

put.description: Update inventory details by product ID

patch.description: Add stock to inventory by product ID
Confirm reserved stock in inventory by product ID
Release reserved stock in inventory by product ID
Remove stock from inventory by product ID
Reserve stock in inventory by product ID

get.description: Get all orders (admins) or the caller's own orders (customers)

parameters.description: Only orders in this status (admins only; ignored for customers)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Get all orders for the authenticated user

patch.description: Cancel an unpaid order and release its stock (own orders only, unless admin). Paid orders are cancelled by refunding the payment.
Move an order through fulfilment (PACKED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED) or cancel an unpaid one (admin only). PAYMENT_PENDING and PAID are set by the payment flow.

post.description: Start checkout for an order, or resume it: an order whose last attempt failed gets the same Razorpay order back to retry

get.description: Get a payment by order ID
Get a summary of payments (admin only)

post.description: Complete a payment from the Razorpay Checkout success response (own orders only, unless admin). Idempotent with the payment.captured webhook.
Process a payment webhook from Razorpay
Refund a captured payment in full through Razorpay (admin only). Cancels the order and releases stock if it has not shipped.

get.description: Get a list of all users (admin only)
Get user details by ID (own profile only, unless admin)

put.description: Update user details by ID (own profile only, unless admin; only admins may change is_active)

patch.description: Change a user's role (admin only). Admins cannot change their own role.
